title: Ginger-Miso Pasta Salad with Edamame, Cabbage & Cucumber

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, soy sauce, miso paste, maple syrup, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; drain and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Add cabbage to the bowl and set aside.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
